question: The battle plans window and the plan as data

addresses.name: BattlePlan_Construct
addresses.comment: The plan object, operator new 0x260. Zeroes the drawing vectors at +0x10..+0x48 and the sub-object at +0x50, keeps the in-game screen at +0x1D0, title "?" (+0x1D4), byte +0x1F0 = 1 (a live, whole plan), file path "" (+0x1F4), +0x210 = 1, +0x21C/+0x21D (0x87 word) = 1 and 0, country tag "---" with id 0, and the four record vectors +0x220..+0x258. `ret 8`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; bare ret 8; written fields match the destructor at 0x2800. A wrong layout would show in BattlePlan_Serialize reading the same offsets.

addresses.name: BattlePlan_Destroy
addresses.comment: Destroys the plan: its drawn objects (0x2A00), the record vectors +0x250, +0x240, +0x230, +0x220, the path +0x1F4 and title +0x1D4 strings, and the vectors below. `ret 4`. Does not free the object; the callers do.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the destroyed fields are those the constructor builds.

addresses.name: BattlePlan_ReadHeader
addresses.comment: Reads **only the first two values** of a `.pln`, for a list row: `title` must be the first key and `country` the second, positional; a title of one or more characters and a country other than id 0 make it good, else +0x210 is cleared. Good: +0x1F0 = 0 (a row for a file, not a live plan) and +0x1F4 = the path. A file exception is logged `Failed to read battle plan header!` and clears +0x210 (catch at 0x316A). `ret 8`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, with the catch. A `#empty` file (six bytes, 17 of the 53 install historical files) fails at the first read, which is what removes those from the historical tab.

addresses.name: BattlePlan_Read
addresses.comment: **The whole format, read positionally**: each key is compared to the next expected token and a wrong key simply leaves that block unread (it is treated as the next one). Order: title, country, optional visibility, arrows_count, (control_points, text)*, matrix_transforms, ignore_smoothing, type, color; icons_count, positions, matrix_transforms, type, color, rotation; texts_count, positions, matrix_transforms, text*, scale, rotation; is_battle_plan_shared; borders_count, (control_points, text)*, matrix_transforms, ignore_smoothing, type, color. Numbers are thousandths, int / 1000.0 as float. Ends with +0x21C = 1 (send it), +0x1F0 = 1 (live) and the path "". `ret 8`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; every token value checked against ghidra/saveTokens.json and against a shipped .pln key for key.

addresses.name: BattlePlan_ReadFile
addresses.comment: Opens the file, a CParseContext, BattlePlan_Read. A file exception logs `Failed to read battle plan!` (catch at 0x4714). `ret 8`.

addresses.name: BattlePlan_Serialize
addresses.signature: void __stdcall BattlePlan_Serialize(void* plan, CSaveWriter* writer, bool full)
addresses.comment: Writes one plan as keys, in the order BattlePlan_Read expects them: title, country, `visibility` (only while +0x1CD is set, which CGameState::SaveContents alone sets for its own write, so a `.pln` never carries it), arrows_count, then per arrow control_points and text, then matrix_transforms, ignore_smoothing, type, color (those four only with one or more arrows); icons_count with positions, matrix_transforms, type, color, rotation; texts_count with positions, matrix_transforms, text each, scale, rotation; is_battle_plan_shared; borders_count with control_points and text each, matrix_transforms, ignore_smoothing, type, color. Coordinates are floor((value + 0.0005) * 1000). A block with no entries is not written. `full` first rebuilds the records from the drawn objects (0x7EC0) and afterwards empties the four record vectors. Callers: BattlePlan_WriteFile and CGameState::SaveContents with 1, the send command with 0. `ret 0xc`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the order reproduces a shipped .pln key for key. A wrong key order would fail against those files.
addresses.revises: The former comment gave the keys loosely and left the other users unchecked; this states the full order, the visibility gate and every caller.

addresses.name: BattlePlan_WriteFile
addresses.comment: Opens `path` for writing and calls BattlePlan_Serialize with full = 1. `ret 8`.

addresses.name: BattlePlan_GetTitle
addresses.comment: Copies the title (+0x1D4). `ret 4`, the out string in ESI.

addresses.name: BattlePlan_GetFilePath
addresses.comment: Copies the path (+0x1F4). `ret 4`, the out string in ESI.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanSendCommand_ConstructFromPlan
addresses.signature: void* __stdcall CBattlePlanSendCommand_ConstructFromPlan(void* self@stack:4, int index@stack:8, void* plan@EDI) @EAX
addresses.comment: The command a changed plan is sent with: token 0x80C, index +0x40, the copy of the plan from CBattlePlanSendCommand_CopyPlan at +0x3C. `ret 8`, plan in EDI.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanSendCommand_CopyPlan
addresses.comment: A fresh 0x260 plan with no screen, its records rebuilt from the source (0x7EC0), country, title, and the shared flag, with +0x21C = whether that flag differs from the zero of a new plan. Null source leaves +0x3C null. `ret 4`, plan in EDI.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanSendCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: **Nothing on the machine of the country that wrote the plan.** On every other: the list of that country (manager +0x350[country id]). If the index is at or past its end, padded with nulls and the plan appended (ownership moves, +0x3C cleared); else the plan at the index has its drawing cleared, records taken from the command, drawn again, title and shared flag copied. Then +0x21C cleared, the shown list rebuilt (0x137B0), and the list box refreshed if tab 0 is up. A null already in the list would be dereferenced: the code assumes indices arrive in order.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; slot 6 of 0x15B4FB4; the CCommand slot 6 name is the record's.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanSendCommand::GetType
addresses.comment: Slot 7: 0x80C, `battle_plan_send`.
addresses.evidence: One mov and ret; the same in the constructor.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanSendCommand::Clone
addresses.comment: Slot 13: a new 0x44 command, plan copied by CBattlePlanSendCommand_CopyPlan (null stays null), index copied. `ret 0x1c`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; slot 13 is the clone in FINDINGS-commands.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanSendCommand::IsValid
addresses.comment: Slot 14: the plan pointer (+0x3C) is not null.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, nine bytes. A false answer deletes the command unrun (slot 14 per FINDINGS-commands).

addresses.name: CBattlePlanDeleteCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: **On every machine.** If the index is within manager +0x350[country id], that plan is removed (0x13970), the shown list rebuilt and, on tab 0, the list box refreshed. Slot 14 is the shared 0xA92590.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanDeleteCommand::GetType

addresses.name: CBattlePlanDeleteCommand::Clone

addresses.name: CConfirmSavePlan::OnConfirm
addresses.comment: Slot 5: BattlePlanManager_WriteSavedPlan with the path kept at +0x70; closes. The byte at 0x1A8554C is cleared; that byte is written by this class and nothing reads it (scan of .text for the address).
addresses.evidence: Read whole. The address scan found only the writers in the class constructor, these slots and the destructor, with the same scan finding every write decompilation showed.

addresses.comment: DefaultConfirm; `mode` 0 for a saved file, `BP_DELETE_SAVED_PLAN_PROMPT`; 1 for a current plan, `BP_DELETE_CURRENT_PLAN_PROMPT`. Keeps screen +0x68, manager +0x6C, plan +0x70 and the mode +0x74, centred on the screen. `ret 0xc`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; mode argument is the ECX the callers set, 0x10EE40 and 0x10FA00.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanEntry_BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: void* __fastcall CBattlePlanEntry_BuildTooltip(void* element@ECX, void* row@stack:4, void* out_tooltip@stack:8) @EAX
addresses.comment: The row's tooltip, for `share_with_allies` and `visibility` only. Share: `BP_TOOLTIP_SHARE_PLAN`, and while the plan is shared a delayed half `BP_SHARED_WITH` plus, for each of the writer's allies, a line `\n- @TAG Name`; none gives `\n- §YNONE§!`. Visibility: `BP_TOOLTIP_VISIBILITY`. Every other element of the row answers nothing. `ret 8`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the element arrives in ECX, the row on the stack, as the caller in CBattlePlanManager::BuildTooltip passes them; the element is compared with the row's +0x3C and +0x44, which would match nothing otherwise.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanEntry::OnVisibilityClicked
addresses.comment: The `visibility` button: flips the plan's +0x1CC. No test at all, whose plan it is.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanEntry::OnShareClicked
addresses.comment: The `share_with_allies` button: where the plan is whole (+0x1F0) and the writer's country is the manager's (+0x3A4), flips +0x21D and sets +0x21C to mean the plan is to be sent.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanEntry::OnBackgroundClicked
addresses.comment: The `background_button`: the row's slot 4 (select, through the listbox item) and the checkbox state to ticked.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanEntry::SetSelected
addresses.comment: Slot 7 of the row. Stores it, clears the background box's two state words unless its +0xD8 is set and +0x136 clear (the same test the record notes on other rows), clears the selection marks of the previous live plan's drawing, then BattlePlanManager_PickSelected and BattlePlanManager_OnSavedRowChosen.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanEntry_UpdateRow
addresses.comment: Slot 9 of the row's table at +0x1C. Each row each frame. The background box's +0x136 is set only where the plan's country is the player's (0xA81AA0 then draws it by state; a box with +0x136 clear draws its last frame). Title text is the plan's title. Flag frame is the country id. `visibility` shown only for a whole plan, frame 1 when visible and 2 when not. `file_path` shown only for a file row. `share_with_allies` shown only for a whole plan of the manager's country, frame 1 shared and 2 not. Second table (object +0x1C), slot 9.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; `this` is the second subobject (+0x1C), which is why plan is +0xC there.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::Show
addresses.comment: Slot 2. Window shown; tab 0; save mode off; the list, the action rows and the tools refreshed.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::Hide
addresses.comment: Slot 3. A live selected plan has its drawn objects unselected first; window hidden. Bound to `close_button` through a slot 3 thunk, and called right after construction.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; slot 3; close_button observer +0x29C holds the slot-3 thunk.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_FillList
addresses.comment: Clears the list box and makes one CBattlePlanEntry per plan of the vector given, in the vector's order. The caller sets EDI to +0x360, +0x370 or +0x380, the tab's list.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the EDI comes from the callers' `lea edi,[esi+...]`.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnNewPlan
addresses.comment: A new plan: title the text of `BP_NEW_PLAN`, +0x1F0 and +0x21C set, visible, the player's country, appended to its country's list; the shown list rebuilt and refilled; selected; rename mode opened on it.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the sequence ends in 0xF110 (rename) and 0x10740.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnRemovePlan
addresses.comment: remove_plan: with a live selected plan of the player's country, the CConfirmDeletePlan dialog, mode 1. Otherwise nothing.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_DeleteCurrentPlan
addresses.comment: Finds the plan's position in the shown list +0x360 and posts a CBattlePlanDeleteCommand with its country and that index. The removal is the command's, on every machine. Bare `ret`. The index works because the player's own plans lead +0x360 in their own order.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; caller CConfirmDeletePlan::OnConfirm passes the manager and plan, as the disassembly at 0x40EF20 compares each list entry with the register holding the plan.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnSavePlan
addresses.comment: save_plan: with a live selected plan of the player's country: +0x394 = it, save mode on, the saved tab, the edit box filled with the title and given focus.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnRenamePlan
addresses.comment: rename_plan: with a live selected plan of the player's country: rename mode on (+0x39D), the edit box filled with the title and given focus.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnSaveConfirm
addresses.comment: save_confirm. **In rename mode**: a non-empty edit box becomes the title (+0x21C set) and the mode ends. **In save mode**: the text trimmed; empty does nothing and the mode stays; any byte 0x80 or above, or `/` or `\\`, opens DefaultInfoDialog `BP_FAILED_SAVE_FILE` / `BP_ILLEGAL_FILE_NAME` and the mode stays. `.pln` is appended unless the name already ends in it after a dot past the first character, case and all. The path is the saved folder, `/`, name; an existing file asks CConfirmSavePlan, otherwise it is written at once.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, 0x626 bytes; the strings at 0x15B5180 and 0x15B5190 are `/` and `\\`.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnSaveCancel
addresses.comment: save_cancel: from save mode, mode off and back on the saved tab; from rename mode, mode off and tab 0.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_WriteSavedPlan
addresses.comment: Writes the plan at +0x394 to `path` if there is one, rescans the saved folder, ends save mode, tab 2.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnLoadPlan
addresses.comment: load_plan, both tabs: with a selected file row (+0x1F0 clear), a new 0x260 plan read whole from the row's path, drawn, visible, appended to the list of **the country in the file**, the shown list rebuilt. The row stays; nothing else changes tab.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; two observers, +0x1C0 and +0x1EC, hold this one handler.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::OnDeletePlan
addresses.comment: delete_plan: with a selected file row, CConfirmDeletePlan mode 0.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_DeleteSavedPlan
addresses.comment: PHYSFS_delete of the row's path, rescan of the saved folder, tab 2.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_RefreshActions
addresses.comment: Shows the action row of the tab and hides the other two when neither save nor rename mode is on. In either mode, shows `save_confirm` (text `BP_SAVE_PLAN_CONFIRM` in save mode, `SM_APPLY` in rename mode), `save_cancel` and `save_editbox`; otherwise hides those three. `ret 4`.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_PickSelected
addresses.comment: A row already selected: its plan becomes +0x390. Otherwise +0x390 is cleared and the first row whose plan is of the manager's country is selected and ticked. Allies' rows are never auto-picked.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_SelectPlan
addresses.comment: Sets +0x390 and selects and ticks that plan's row.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::Reload
addresses.comment: Slot 0, also called by the constructor. Tears down and rebuilds: the tool settings; the player's country (+0x3A0); the shown list, the historical and saved scans; every element by name; `tools`, `options_window` and `text_prompt_window` start hidden; the option buttons from `battleplan_tool_option_entry`; shows the window; tab 0.

addresses.name: CBattlePlanManager::BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: void* __thiscall CBattlePlanManager::BuildTooltip(CBattlePlanManager* this, void* out_tooltip, void* element)
addresses.comment: Slot 4. Tabs: `BP_TOOLTIP_TAB_CURRENT`, `..._HISTORICAL`, `..._SAVED`. Actions: `BP_TOOLTIP_NEW_PLAN`, `..._REMOVE_PLAN`, `..._SAVE_PLAN`, `..._RENAME_PLAN`; `BP_TOOLTIP_IMPORT_PLAN` on either load_plan; delete_plan `BP_TOOLTIP_REMOVE_PLAN`. Rows go through CBattlePlanEntry_BuildTooltip. `ret 8`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; tools and tool options are the drawing reader's.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_SendChangedPlans
addresses.comment: Every 2.0 seconds of the clock, in a multiplayer game only (the caller tests the screen's +0x68), for each plan in the player's country list with +0x21C set: clears it and posts a CBattlePlanSendCommand with the plan and its index.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the caller condition at 0x255F31 is disassembled; the 2.0 is the double at 0x160A360.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_InitLists
addresses.comment: One empty plan vector per country in the database, into +0x350.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_ClearAll
addresses.comment: The destructor's step: empties the shown list and every country's vector.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_RebuildShown
addresses.comment: +0x360: the player's country's own list, whole, in its order, then for every other country in id order each plan with +0x21D set whose writer lists the player's country in CCountry Allies. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the Allies walk is the record's CCountry +0xF88.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_RemovePlan
addresses.comment: Takes the plan out of its country's list and of +0x360, clears +0x390 where it was the selected one, destroys it.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_ScanHistorical
addresses.comment: Empties +0x370 and makes a row for every file (no extension filter) in the historical folder, reading each header. Rows whose header failed are destroyed. Order as PHYSFS gives. `ret 4`.

addresses.name: BattlePlanManager_ScanSaved
addresses.comment: The same for +0x380 and the saved folder, **without the failed-header check**: a bad file stays a row, titled "?" unless its title was read, country id 0.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the check present in 0x13A40 is absent here.
